bundle.shortDescription: Cross-platform Steam library categorizer and AutoCat manager
bundle.longDescription: Depressurizer is an autonomous, cross-platform Steam library categorization and AutoCat management utility. It connects directly to your installed Steam client and official Steam Web APIs to organize your game collection with zero telemetry.
